이어 1979년 이슬람 혁명으로 권력을 잡은
이란의 시아파 정권이 '저항의 축' 지원을 통해 이스라엘을 압박했고,
이스라엘은 이란의 핵 개발을 저지하는 등 맞대응을 이어나가면서
중동 지역의 긴장이 고조됐다고 분석했습니다.

전문가들은 이스라엘과 이란 모두 중요한 전략적 파트너인 만큼
호르무즈 해협 봉쇄에 따른 경제적 타격에 대비하고,정치·외교에 미칠 영향을 점검해야 한다고 강조했습니다.

YTN 탐사보도 프로그램 '팩트추적'은
이란 사태의 역사적 뿌리를 살펴보고, 호르무즈 해협 봉쇄 속 우리의 대응책을 조명합니다.

en-US.title: [Fact Tracking] U.S. Wars, the Achilles' Heel Behind: Dollar Hegemony / YTN
en-US.description:
Analysis suggests that the economic motive of defending the dollar hegemony, symbolized by the "petrodollar," played a role in the U.S. carrying out airstrikes on Iran and the arrest of the Venezuelan president.

According to coverage by YTN's investigative program "Fact Tracking," experts pointed out a tendency for the U.S. to respond aggressively, including through military attacks, against countries that attempted to switch oil payments to the euro or their own currencies.

In fact, it was found that not only Iran’s attempt to use the yuan for payments and Venezuela’s attempt to use the cryptocurrency "Petro," but also Iraq and Libya, experienced military intervention and regime collapse following their attempts to replace dollar payments.

The petrodollar system, established through an agreement between the U.S. and Saudi Arabia in 1974, is considered a core structure that has supported U.S. fiscal and military power while maintaining global demand for the dollar. YTN’s "Fact Tracker," airing on Wednesday night (the 6th), focuses on the fate of Petro nations that attempted to de-dollarize and the survival strategies of our economy amidst the wavering dollar hegemony. en-US.title: [Fact Tracking Preview] Oil Payments? In Dollars! Why? / YTN
en-US.description:
Analysis suggests that the economic motive of defending dollar hegemony, symbolized by the 'petrodollar,' played a role in the U.S. carrying out airstrikes on Iran and the arrest of the Venezuelan president.

According to coverage by YTN's investigative program 'Fact Tracking,' experts pointed out that the U.S. has a tendency to respond aggressively, including through military attacks, against countries that attempted to switch oil payments to the euro or their own currencies.

In fact, it was revealed that not only Iran’s attempt to use the yuan for payments and Venezuela’s attempt to use the cryptocurrency 'Petro,' but also Iraq and Libya experienced military intervention and regime collapse following their attempts to replace dollar payments.

The petrodollar system, established through an agreement between the U.S. and Saudi Arabia in 1974, is considered a core structure that has supported U.S. fiscal and military power while maintaining global demand for the dollar. YTN’s “Fact Tracking,” airing on Wednesday night (the 6th), focuses on the fate of petro-nations that attempted to move away from the dollar, and the survival strategies of our economy amidst the wavering dollar hegemony. id.title: [Pratinjau Pelacakan Fakta] Pembayaran Minyak? Dalam Dolar! Mengapa? / YTN
id.description:
Analisis menunjukkan bahwa motif ekonomi untuk mempertahankan hegemoni dolar, yang dilambangkan oleh 'petrodolar,' berperan dalam serangan udara AS terhadap Iran dan penangkapan presiden Venezuela.

Menurut liputan program investigasi YTN 'Fact Tracking,' para ahli menunjukkan bahwa AS cenderung merespons secara agresif, termasuk melalui serangan militer, terhadap negara-negara yang mencoba mengalihkan pembayaran minyak ke euro atau mata uang mereka sendiri.

Faktanya, terungkap bahwa bukan hanya upaya Iran untuk menggunakan yuan untuk pembayaran dan upaya Venezuela untuk menggunakan mata uang kripto 'Petro,' tetapi juga Irak dan Libya mengalami intervensi militer dan keruntuhan rezim setelah upaya mereka untuk mengganti pembayaran dolar.

Sistem petrodolar, yang didirikan melalui perjanjian antara AS dan Arab Saudi pada tahun 1974, dianggap sebagai struktur inti yang telah mendukung kekuatan fiskal dan militer AS sambil mempertahankan permintaan global terhadap dolar. Program "Fact Tracking" di YTN, yang tayang pada Rabu malam (tanggal 6), berfokus pada nasib negara-negara penghasil minyak yang mencoba beralih dari dolar, dan strategi bertahan hidup ekonomi kita di tengah goyahnya hegemoni dolar. snippet.title: [팩트추적] 전쟁의 시대, 위협의 역사 / YTN
snippet.description:
지난 2월 발생한 이란 사태가 장기화 국면에 접어든 가운데,
이번 전쟁이 단기간의 신경전이 아니라
이스라엘과 이란의 오랜 갈등의 역사에서 비롯됐다는 분석이 나옵니다.

YTN 탐사보도 프로그램 '팩트추적'이 만난 중동 전문가들은 1948년 건국된 이스라엘이
팔레스타인을 배척하면서 이슬람 국가와의 갈등이 시작됐다고 밝혔습니다.

이어 1979년 이슬람 혁명으로 권력을 잡은
이란의 시아파 정권이 '저항의 축' 지원을 통해 이스라엘을 압박했고,
이스라엘은 이란의 핵 개발을 저지하는 등 맞대응을 이어나가면서
